# Plan

`import { Plan } from "@/components/agent-ui/plan"`

## Use for
- The assistant's intended steps, shown in the thread before it runs them or as it checks them off.

## Do not use for
- The live status of a running agent. Use `AgentDock`.
- One tool invocation. Use `ToolCall`.
- A to-do list that belongs to the user. Use the project's task list.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | Optional heading, the name of the task. |
| `steps` | `{ id, label, detail?, status }[]` | Required. `status` is `"pending"`, `"running"`, `"done"`, or `"error"`. |
| `labels` | `Partial<Record<status, string>>` | Accessible names for the status icons. Set them when the interface is not in English. |

## Example
```tsx
<Plan
  title="Replace hardcoded colors"
  steps={[
    { id: "find", label: "Find hex colors", status: "done" },
    { id: "map", label: "Map each one to a token", status: "running" },
    { id: "edit", label: "Edit SettingsPage.tsx", status: "pending" },
  ]}
/>
```

## Rules
- At most one step has `status="running"`.
- A step that needs permission stays `pending` until `Approval` resolves. Do not mark it `done` early.
- Render the plan as a sibling of `Message`, not as a markdown numbered list inside the message.
